headline.purpose: The one screen title per page.

title.purpose: Section heads in condensed capitals, always on a card-ink rule.

body.purpose: Running text, cells, nav items and form labels.

punch.purpose: Every time, date and duration; condensed mono on tabular, slashed-zero figures.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: The only shadow: keyboard focus on buttons. Inputs use a 2px ring at 35% violet. Surfaces are flat.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Colour, border and 1px press changes on state only; no entrance motion; removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Rack becomes the left rail; bottom bar hides; controls drop from 44px to 36px.

extensions.colorScheme: Light by default; dark via prefers-color-scheme (values in colorMeta.*.dark).

components.description: The one violet action per form.

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline{font-family:var(--font-sans,'Archivo Variable',sans-serif);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:44px;padding:0 16px;border:1px solid var(--input,oklch(0.62 0.035 252));border-radius:4px;background:var(--card,oklch(0.99 0.005 236));color:var(--foreground,oklch(0.255 0.04 262));font-size:15px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms ease-out,border-color 150ms ease-out,transform 150ms ease-out}.ds-btn-outline:hover{border-color:color-mix(in oklch,var(--foreground,oklch(0.255 0.04 262)) 60%,transparent);background:var(--accent,oklch(0.915 0.025 240))}.ds-btn-outline:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--background,oklch(0.955 0.016 236)),0 0 0 4px var(--ring,oklch(0.46 0.165 308))}.ds-btn-outline:active{transform:translateY(1px)}

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Red outline that fills red on hover; destructive actions only.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive{font-family:var(--font-sans,'Archivo Variable',sans-serif);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:44px;padding:0 16px;border:1px solid color-mix(in oklch,var(--destructive,oklch(0.52 0.19 25)) 60%,transparent);border-radius:4px;background:var(--card,oklch(0.99 0.005 236));color:var(--destructive,oklch(0.52 0.19 25));font-size:15px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms ease-out,color 150ms ease-out}.ds-btn-destructive:hover{background:var(--destructive,oklch(0.52 0.19 25));color:var(--primary-foreground,oklch(0.985 0.006 308))}.ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--background,oklch(0.955 0.016 236)),0 0 0 4px var(--destructive,oklch(0.52 0.19 25))}

components.name: Ruled Field
components.description: One form field on one ruled line: label column, then the input.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;grid-template-columns:12rem minmax(0,1fr);align-items:center;gap:8px 16px;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border,oklch(0.83 0.028 245));font-family:var(--font-sans,'Archivo Variable',sans-serif)}.ds-field-label{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1;color:var(--foreground,oklch(0.255 0.04 262))}.ds-input{height:36px;padding:4px 10px;border:1px solid var(--input,oklch(0.62 0.035 252));border-radius:4px;background:var(--card,oklch(0.99 0.005 236));color:var(--foreground,oklch(0.255 0.04 262));font:inherit;font-size:15px;outline:none;transition:border-color 150ms ease-out,box-shadow 150ms ease-out}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--muted-foreground,oklch(0.45 0.035 256))}.ds-input:hover{border-color:color-mix(in oklch,var(--foreground,oklch(0.255 0.04 262)) 60%,transparent)}.ds-input:focus-visible{border-color:var(--ring,oklch(0.46 0.165 308));box-shadow:0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch,var(--ring,oklch(0.46 0.165 308)) 35%,transparent)}

components.name: Ruled Table
components.description: Section head on an ink rule, column-head band, hairline-ruled lines, punched dates.
components.css: .ds-ruled{font-family:var(--font-sans,'Archivo Variable',sans-serif);color:var(--foreground,oklch(0.255 0.04 262))}.ds-printed-head{margin:0;padding-bottom:6px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--foreground,oklch(0.255 0.04 262));font-size:15px;font-weight:650;font-stretch:72%;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.05em}.ds-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:15px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-table thead{background:var(--muted,oklch(0.93 0.02 238))}.ds-table th{height:36px;padding:0 12px;text-align:left;border-bottom:1px solid var(--input,oklch(0.62 0.035 252));color:var(--muted-foreground,oklch(0.45 0.035 256));font-size:13px;font-weight:650;font-stretch:72%;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.05em}.ds-table td{padding:10px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border,oklch(0.83 0.028 245))}.ds-table tbody tr{transition:background-color 150ms ease-out}.ds-table tbody tr:hover{background:color-mix(in oklch,var(--accent,oklch(0.915 0.025 240)) 50%,transparent)}.ds-punch{font-family:var(--font-mono,'Martian Mono Variable',monospace);font-stretch:75%;font-size:13px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums slashed-zero}.ds-spent{color:var(--muted-foreground,oklch(0.45 0.035 256));text-decoration:line-through;text-decoration-thickness:1px}

narrative.overview:
The app is a time card in a rack. The ground is pale blue card stock, everything is printed on it in blue-black card ink, and the grid shows as thin printed rules rather than boxes. The shell is the time rack: a deep ink rail on the PC, a slim ink bar on top and an ink navigation bar at the bottom on the phone. The current screen is the card pulled into its slot: the active rail item is filled with card stock and runs flush into the work area.

It is a working tool for one person, used for seconds on the phone and for long dense sessions on the PC. Rank comes from weight, capitals and rules, not from colour, panels or shadow. Two ribbon inks are held back for meaning: violet for what is live and for the one primary action, red for what is irregular or destructive. Times, dates and durations are punched in a condensed monospace on fixed columns.

It deliberately is not a grey SaaS dashboard with stat tiles and an indigo accent. Light is the default; dark follows the device setting through `prefers-color-scheme`, so it works without JavaScript.
keyCharacteristics: Card stock ground, card ink text, every grey a tint of the card ink.
Rules instead of boxes; a heavy ink rule under each section head, hairlines between lines.
Printed condensed capitals for section and column heads.
Condensed monospace on tabular figures for every punched time, date and duration.
Violet for live or primary, red for irregular or destructive.
4 px corners, no shadows, colour-only motion at 150 ms.

rules.name: The Four Inks Rule
rules.body: Stock, card ink, violet and red. Any other tone must be a tint of the card ink at hue 236 to 262. No neutral greys.

rules.name: The Ribbon Rule
rules.body: Violet means live, the primary action, or where your input is focused. Red means irregular or destructive. Neither colours decoration, headings or icons.

rules.name: The Three Sizes Rule
rules.body: Working screens use 13, 15 and 22 px. Rank is made with weight, capitals and rules, not new sizes. The only exceptions are 16 px phone inputs and the wordmark.

rules.name: The Punch Rule
rules.body: If it is a time, date or duration, it is punched in the condensed mono. Nothing else is.

rules.name: The Rules-Not-Boxes Rule
rules.body: A screen region is a heading on a heavy ink rule followed by hairline-ruled lines. Do not wrap regions in bordered or filled panels. Bordered boxes are for controls and messages only.

dos: **Do** put every screen region under a printed section head on a 1 px card-ink rule.
**Do** set every time, date and duration in the punch style.
**Do** keep one violet primary button per form; use outline buttons for the rest.
**Do** strike through spent or archived items and mark them with a spent badge.
**Do** keep 44 px targets on the phone and the bottom bar inside thumb reach.
**Do** keep motion to 150 ms ease-out colour changes on state, removed under reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** use neutral greys; tint the card ink instead.
**Don't** use violet or red for decoration, headings or icons.
**Don't** wrap screen regions in cards, panels or shadows.
**Don't** add text sizes beyond 13, 15 and 22 px on working screens.
